FONTSHOW · metric aliases

Metric-alias CSS stacks

With --use-metric-font-aliases / UseMetricFontAliases and substitutes in the registry, these stacks pick Gelasio / Cousine / Arimo / Tinos. Without the flag they continue to generics / Liberation.

CSS stackSampleOpt-in face
Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif Northline brief set in a Georgia stack. Gelasio
"Courier New", monospace mono payload: ORDER-57-ALIAS Cousine
Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif Sans stack aimed at Arimo when present. Arimo
"Times New Roman", Times, serif Serif stack aimed at Tinos when present. Tinos
